features.title: Repo boots from a clean clone
features.user_visible_behavior: Running ./init.sh on a fresh clone installs dependencies and runs verification to completion.
evidence: Baseline. Every new feature starts from this passing state.

features.title: Dictation pipeline units
features.user_visible_behavior: Gesture detection, Groq transcription, paste injection, settings storage and the session orchestrator exist as tested main-process units.
features.plan: none: main-process units with no UI, specified in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-21-parley-design.md
verification: Run `make check` and confirm the electron/__tests__ suites pass.

features.title: Orb window records and animates
features.user_visible_behavior: A floating orb appears while the gesture key is held, reacts to the voice, and sends the recording to the main process.
features.plan: none: canvas-only overlay window, approved as ASCII wireframes in the design spec
verification: Run `make dev`, perform the gesture and watch the orb states.

features.title: Settings and onboarding window
features.user_visible_behavior: The tray opens a settings window that shows permission status, stores the Groq key and edits gesture, vocabulary, tick sound and launch at login.
features.plan: none: single form window, approved as ASCII wireframes in the design spec
verification: Run `make dev` and change each setting.

features.title: End-to-end dictation verified by hand
features.user_visible_behavior: Dictation pastes into Safari, Chrome, Slack, VS Code, Terminal and Notes.
features.plan: none: packaging config and a manual checklist, no UI
